name: Curlicue
description: Commas laid on the flow, each one turned to its own bearing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @shape: drop; -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958deg); transform: rotate(@calc@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
